name: ingenidev, Oman – OMR Currency Symbol Changer مغير رمز عملة الريال العماني
author: ingenidev by Bright Vortex LLC

sections.description:
NEW Plugin!

How to Change the Omani Riyal (OMR) Currency Symbol in WooCommerce?

By default, WooCommerce uses ر.ع. as the symbol for the Omani Riyal (OMR), which may not always align with your website’s branding or customer preferences. If you want to replace ر.ع. with the official OMR symbol, this plugin makes the process effortless.

Why Change the OMR Symbol in WooCommerce?

Many businesses prefer displaying OMR’s official symbol instead of ر.ع. for better readability, consistency, and international appeal. Some common reasons include:
– Maintaining a uniform look across your website, especially when using English as the primary language.
– Enhancing clarity for non-Arabic-speaking customers who may not recognize ر.ع. as OMR.
– Improving compatibility with third-party payment gateways or invoice systems that use the official OMR symbol.
– Professional presentation for international e-commerce stores.

Features of the Omani Riyal OMR Currency Symbol Changer Plugin:

✅ Instantly Replace “ر.ع.” with “OMR’s official symbol” across your WooCommerce store.
✅ No coding required – simple plug-and-play functionality.
✅ Works seamlessly with all WooCommerce-compatible themes and plugins.
✅ Lightweight and fast – no performance impact on your store.
✅ Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
✅ Supports both frontend and admin area displays.
✅ Custom font implementation for proper symbol rendering.

How to Use This Plugin?

  1. Install and activate the OMR Currency Symbol Changer plugin.
  2. The plugin automatically updates the currency symbol from ر.ع. to OMR’s official symbol across your WooCommerce store.
  3. No additional configuration is required – it just works!

Who Should Use This Plugin?

– WooCommerce store owners in Oman or those selling to customers in Oman.
– Businesses that prefer the official “OMR symbol” format over the Arabic “ر.ع.”.
– Websites that use English as the primary language and want a consistent currency display.
– International e-commerce stores that need standardized currency symbols.

Get Started Today!

Upgrade your WooCommerce store’s currency display with the Oman OMR Currency Symbol Changer and ensure a better shopping experience for your customers.

Privacy notices

This plugin, in itself, does not:

  • track users
  • write any user personal data to the database
  • send any data to external servers
  • make use of cookies

Our plugins

The following plugins are recommended by ingenidev:

  • Code Widget for Elementor This plugin for Elementor adds a widget for a code snippet to your pages, the snippet includes code formatting and a built in copy to clipboard function.
  • Cash on Delivery Shield A plugin that allows you to disable Cash on Delivery payment method for orders made by users who are not logged in.
  • KSA SAR Currency Symbol Changer Change the Saudi Riyal currency symbol in WooCommerce.

Support

Do you have questions or issues with OMR Currency Symbol Changer? Use these support channels appropriately:

  1. Website
  2. Plugin Page
  3. Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ingenidev-oman-omr-currency-symbol-changer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. The currency symbol will automatically change when OMR is selected as your store currency.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme that properly supports WooCommerce.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Do I need to configure anything?

No configuration is needed. Simply install, activate, and the plugin will automatically change the OMR currency symbol.

Does this affect my store’s performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and has no impact on your store’s performance.
